## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates understanding of cross-region consistency, race conditions, and idempotent processing in event-driven architectures. It validates practical knowledge of distributed systems testing, including event sourcing, conflict resolution, and exactly-once delivery semantics.

- Eventual consistency and data races across geographic regions
- Idempotency and exactly-once processing semantics
